professionalSummary.text: Senior software engineer with over two years of experience on a search indexing pipeline, responsible for writing indexing jobs, schema changes, and managing full index rebuilds.

professionalSummary.text: Proven track record of validating changes against a replay corpus before merging, ensuring reliability and consistency.
professionalSummary.witness: Proved every change on the replay corpus before merge, attaching the replay result to the merge request; the replay results for the last two years sit in the pipeline repository.

professionalSummary.text: Effective communicator with customer-facing support teams, addressing indexing delay queries and documenting responsibilities.
professionalSummary.witness: Answered the customer-facing support engineers' questions about indexing delays in the pipeline support channel, marking in each thread which answers were mine and which were referred to the pipeline lead.

professionalSummary.text: Consistently documents change boundaries and hand‑over notes, ensuring clear knowledge transfer for future engineers.
professionalSummary.witness: Left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover and what the next engineer needed to know.
